env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

cd lgo
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgo$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:10:\d+: warning: \[perf::large_backing_array_pin\] subslice of a 65537-byte backing array escapes'
stderr 'main\.lgo:18:10: warning: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\] time\.After in a loop body'
exists $WORK/bin/lgo$GOEXE
cd ..

cd lgodeny
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgodeny$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:5:\d+: \[perf::large_backing_array_pin\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
! exists $WORK/bin/lgodeny$GOEXE
cd ..

cd lgodenytime
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgodenytime$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:13:10: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
! exists $WORK/bin/lgodenytime$GOEXE
cd ..

cd lgoallow
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoallow$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/lgoallow$GOEXE
cd ..

cd lgoallowed
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoallowed$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/lgoallowed$GOEXE
cd ..

cd gopkg
logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:10:\d+: warning: \[perf::large_backing_array_pin\] subslice of a 65537-byte backing array escapes'
stderr 'main\.go:18:10: warning: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\]'
! exists gopkg
! exists gopkg$GOEXE
logos build ./...
! stderr .
go build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd godeny
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:5:\d+: \[perf::large_backing_array_pin\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr '"severity":"deny","rule_id":"perf::large_backing_array_pin","file":"[^"]*main\.go","span":\{"start_line":5,'
cd ..

cd godenytime
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:13:10: \[perf::time_after_in_loop\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

cd gopkg
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr '"severity":"warn","rule_id":"perf::large_backing_array_pin","file":"[^"]*main\.go","span":\{"start_line":10,'
cd ..

-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/lgo

go 1.27

-- lgo/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

func head() []byte {
	var buf [65537]byte
	return buf[:10]
}

func wait(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) {
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-time.After(d):
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	println(len(head()))
	wait(context.Background(), time.Millisecond)
}

-- lgoallowed/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoallowed

go 1.27

-- lgoallowed/logos.toml --
[lints]
perf = "deny"

-- lgoallowed/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

func head() []byte {
	var buf [65537]byte
	//logos:allow(perf::large_backing_array_pin)
	return buf[:10]
}

func wait(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) {
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		//logos:allow(perf::time_after_in_loop)
		case <-time.After(d):
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	println(len(head()))
	wait(context.Background(), time.Millisecond)
}
